name: Dried milk (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Dried milk [Milk and milk products] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 173454 (Milk, dry, whole, without added vitamin D)
Prosser et al., 'Amino Acid Composition of Dried Bovine Dairy Powders', PMC11640299
Supplee & Bellis, 'Citric acid content of milk and milk products', J Biol Chem (bulk-milk mean 0.172%)
Larsen / Agrarforschung Schweiz 2008 and PMC8614319 (orotic acid in cow milk 6.3-7.6 mg/100 g fluid)
provenance.curation_notes: DOMINANT carbon/energy source is lactose (38.4 g/100g); citric acid (~1.36 g/100g) and orotic acid (~0.051 g/100g) are the key organic-acid omissions now added (scaled from fluid-milk concentrations by the ~8x powder concentration factor, protein 3.3%->26.3%). Milk protein (26.3 g) supplies the full amino-acid pool and milk fat (26.7 g, palmitate/oleate-rich) the lipids. Cholesterol is retained as a genuine animal-food sterol. Amino acids are total (acid-hydrolysis) values, not free.
curation_added: citric acid (~1.36 g/100g) - principal milk organic acid, was absent
orotic acid (~0.051 g/100g) - characteristic milk pyrimidine acid, was absent
lactose quantified (38.4 g/100g) - dominant fermentable sugar
full quantitative amino-acid profile (18 AAs with g/100g)
individual fatty acids with amounts (16:0, 18:1, 14:0, 18:0, 4:0, etc.)
vitamins and minerals with real USDA amounts
lactic acid flagged as trace (unfermented product)

curation_removed.name: D-Serine
curation_removed.reason: Milk protein contains L-serine, not the D-enantiomer; D-serine is a FooDB stereochemical mis-assignment. Replaced with L-serine.

curation_removed.name: (±)-erythro-Isoleucine
curation_removed.reason: Stereochemical artifact/duplicate of L-isoleucine; not a distinct milk nutrient.

curation_removed.name: Nonanoate
curation_removed.reason: C9:0 (nonanoic acid) is not a meaningful bovine milk-fat fatty acid; FooDB trace/predicted noise (real odd-chain milk FAs are C15:0/C17:0).

curation_removed.name: Fe2+ mitochondria
curation_removed.reason: Subcellular-compartment artifact duplicating iron; consolidated into a single 'iron' entry.

curation_removed.name: epsilon-Polylysine
curation_removed.reason: Microbial food-preservative additive, not a native constituent of milk; FooDB noise.

curation_removed.name: (R)-Oxypeucedanin
curation_removed.reason: Plant furanocoumarin (Apiaceae/citrus); biologically implausible in bovine milk; FooDB predicted, not measured.

curation_removed.name: (E)-2-Phenyl-2-butenal
curation_removed.reason: Trace Strecker/flavor volatile aldehyde, not a growth-relevant nutrient.

curation_removed.name: Nickel
curation_removed.reason: Ultra-trace non-nutritive contaminant element, not a defined milk growth nutrient.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
